To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
coplanar contact pads can be used for RF characterisation of nanowire transistors.

the coplanar contact layout has a lower parasitic capacitance than the conventional layout and that the scattering parameters and the extracted small signal parameters of a single InAs nanowire field effect transistor (FET) with the coplanar layout show a better performance than the conventional layout.
the contact pattern for single nanowire transistors can be designed to minimize parasitic capacitance and thus to improve the RF performance of the device.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel device structures and their characterisation.
the development and characterization of nanowire based field-effect transistor (FET) structures for RF-applications.
the development of novel nanoscaled devices and their characterisation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
coplanar contact patterns are suitable for the RF-characterization of nanoscaled transistors.
the developed coplanar contact structure is suitable for the RF-characterization of single nanowire transistors.
the coplanar contact layout exhibits an improved parasitic capacitance and thus a better high frequency performance than a conventional layout.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the coplanar contact layout is a promising candidate for future RF- and high-frequency applications of nanoscaled transistors.
the coplanar contact pad layout has been successfully developed and experimentally verified.
the coplanar contact layout is a viable solution to the problem of low parasitic capacitances and that the contact pattern is suitable for the RF characterisation of nanoscale transistors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the coplanar layout allows for the reduction of the coupling capacitance by a factor of 3, which is of particular importance for nanowire devices.
the coplanar contact layout allows for a more accurate extraction of the intrinsic device characteristics.
the coplanar contact layout is a promising alternative to the conventional contact pattern, which can be applied to nanoscaled devices with a low parasitic coupling and pad capacitance.
